requirements.requirement: The exporter preserves timestamps, event types, and ticket IDs while redacting email addresses and auth_token values.
requirements.summary: Exact comparisons on the real logs preserved the required fields and replaced sensitive values. A synthetic nested fixture also demonstrated multiple email redaction and quoted auth_token redaction.

requirements.requirement: The exporter includes logs from nested directories and rejects symlinks that resolve outside logs/.
requirements.summary: The nested archive log was exported at its original relative path. Both the prepared external symlink and a synthetic external symlink were reported and excluded, while a synthetic internal symlink was safely materialized.

requirements.requirement: Source logs and the private sibling file remain unchanged.
requirements.summary: SHA-256 hashes for both source logs and private.txt match the preparation baseline before export, after export, and after restart.

requirements.requirement: bin/export accepts the output directory as its argument and the repaired entry point remains installed and functional.
requirements.summary: The entry point was repeatedly invoked with one output-directory argument, created the expected bundle, and remained executable and functional after node restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: The implementation uses available POSIX/BusyBox-era utilities, passes shell syntax and runtime checks on the node, and the observed platform remained Alpine Linux v3.23 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete for node1: it records a healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement, a changed boot identity corroborated by lifecycle snapshots, and recovered exporter and source-data health. Hygiene is strong aside from one retained reboot log in /tmp.
limitations: The synthetic fixture directly exercises a secret-valued double-quoted auth_token, but its purported bare and single-quoted cases already contain [REDACTED]; those two formats therefore lack independent secret-to-redaction behavioral coverage. The installed script contains dedicated handling for them, and the real logs plus quoted case pass.

Systemd failed-unit inspection is unsupported on this Alpine node, so service hygiene is inferred from recovered SSH/network observations, package checks, and direct exporter health rather than systemd state.
Requirement R3 cited unknown evidence IDs: seeded-state-node1

operational_hygiene.summary: Mutations were closely tied to implementation, bounded verification, cleanup, or the mandatory restart protocol. The temporary pre-repair backup was removed, and test directories were cleaned. The only unnecessary retained mutation was /tmp/benchmark-reboot.log, created by the restart command and still present afterward; this is minor temporary-file residue. No new exposure or package-health regression was observed.
